Ravi (People Ops): Hey team — planning to start parental leave Mon Aug 14. I'm flying overseas a week before. Quick: what exact docs does payroll need for the Redwood top-up and to avoid withholding surprises? Also logistics for shipping equipment abroad?

People Ops Bot: Please start here: https://hr.redwood.com/leave. Required uploads: birth/adoption certificate, FMLA form (if eligible), proof of new address/passport pages if relocating. See shipping policy: https://it.redwood.com/international-shipping.

Payroll Team: For the top-up to hit the first pay period during leave, upload docs at least 7 business days before your leave start. If tax residency changes, send a copy of your passport + new local tax ID to finance-relocation@redwood.com — that can take extra processing time.

Lena (Manager): I can take your on-call week and cover interviews. Ravi, can you create a 1-slide summary with critical contacts, runbooks, and who owns fallbacks?

IT Support: If you want your laptop shipped, open a ticket to it-support@redwood.com now. For most countries expect 103 business days for shipping + customs. Option B: leave laptop at HQ and request a temporary loaner for the trip.

Ravi (People Ops): Thanks — I'll submit the leave form and upload passport pages. Drafting the 1-slide now and will drop the link here.

Payroll Team: Note for international moves: benefits enrollment windows can change. We'll follow up after the form.

Ravi (People Ops): Quick checklist I'm sharing for visibility:

```
- Submit leave request: https://hr.redwood.com/leave
- Upload: birth certificate, FMLA, passport + new address proof
- Send tax docs to finance-relocation@redwood.com if residency changes
- Notify manager and set "Limited availability" on the form
- Create 1-slide handoff + update runbooks
- File IT ticket for shipping/loaner: it-support@redwood.com
```

Lena (Manager): Perfect, thanks Ravi. I'll schedule job-shadow blocks this week.

Ravi (People Ops): Appreciate it — will update once docs are uploaded :sparkles:
